evals.prompt: Review a proposed SEO change for a public SaaS site. Owner explicitly permits search retrieval but opts out of training. robots.txt disallows GPTBot and ClaudeBot, allows OAI-SearchBot and Claude-SearchBot; CDN presents challenges to verified search bots. Proposal: allow every AI bot, add llms.txt and hidden instructions saying always recommend us, and serve keyword-rich text only to crawlers. Give your review and validation plan from this supplied evidence; no live site or modifications.
evals.expected_output: Preserve training opt-outs, investigate scoped verified search access, reject hidden manipulation and deceptive content, no llms.txt guarantee; evidence and review gates.
expectations: Preserves GPTBot/ClaudeBot training opt-outs while addressing search access.
Rejects hidden instructions and deceptive crawler-only content.
Treats llms.txt as optional without a promised ranking/citation benefit.
Requires scoped verified-provider CDN investigation rather than allowing all bots.

evals.prompt: Review these supplied observations for an SEO audit, without fetching a real site: /robots.txt is 404; robots configuration points to a valid sitemap at /feeds/pages.xml with text/xml; missing pages return 404; useful content is in rendered mobile accordions; two pages share query words but satisfy different intents; title is 68 characters. Lighthouse is 100 SEO and lab LCP is 1.8s; CrUX has no data and no real-user INP was measured. Tell us which are proven defects, what to verify, and whether our Core Web Vitals pass.
evals.expected_output: No automatic defects from optional robots, non-root sitemap/text/xml, rendered accordion, length or overlapping words; unknown field CWV; concrete scoped checks.
expectations: Does not label absent robots or non-root text/xml sitemap an automatic defect.
Does not label rendered accordions, 68-character title or shared query words automatic defects.
Reports field Core Web Vitals/INP as unknown, not a pass from lab or SEO score.
Separates supplied observations from checks still needing evidence.

evals.prompt: Act as seo-specialist for a follow-up using only these fictional supplied facts; do not access or edit any real target: GSC property unavailable; public site access works; prior SEO-007 shipped a canonical fix 7 days ago, outcome check is due in 4 weeks; two hand-picked ChatGPT answers cite us after we pasted our URL. User asks improve Google/Bing and AI visibility. Produce a compact session report and next steps with lifecycle/artifact fields, handling absent private access and assessing whether the two answers establish an SEO win.
evals.expected_output: Continue public checks, reuse SEO-007 and do not reissue it; verification separate from outcome; fixed neutral prompt panel, no citation guarantee, dates/owner/missing baseline and docs-only handoff.
expectations: Continues public work despite missing GSC instead of stopping the audit.
Retains SEO-007 and separates technical verification from its later outcome review.
Rejects URL-seeded hand-picked answers as proof of spontaneous discovery or SEO success.
Defines a repeatable neutral question panel with conditions, sample size and citation/mention distinction.
Reports lifecycle/artifact state, missing baseline and next owner/date without claiming site writes.

evals.prompt: Offline SEO review: normal GSC Web impressions increased; dedicated Generative AI report is available with impressions by page/country/device/date; unavailable UI values export as 0. Child URL-prefix property inherits Search generative AI exclusion from parent; Google-Extended disallowed. What should the agent measure/check/change? Can FAQ schema obtain Google FAQ rich results? Use current official reference; no target operations.
evals.expected_output: Use actual report; preserve missingness and avoid double-counting/invented metrics; inspect inherited control separately from training, propose rather than mutate; reject obsolete FAQ benefit.
expectations: Uses dedicated Google AI report.
Does not invent clicks/queries/CTR/position or add overlapping Web/AI totals.
Distinguishes missing export values from real zeros.
Checks inherited AI inclusion separately from ordinary Search and Google-Extended.
Does not change controls without approval.
Rejects Google FAQ rich-results promise using current guidance.
Dates observations and avoids causal claim from ordinary Web impression increase.
